title: Three Worlds
subtitle: One surface holds what floats on it, what it mirrors and what lies beneath
technique: Reflection and refraction at a water surface, weighted per pixel by the exact Fresnel equations: the reflected ray samples a mirror-camera image of the world above, and the refracted ray is traced by Snell's law through absorbing water to a ray-marched carp and the pond bottom
blurb: Fallen leaves, mirrored trees and a carp share one winter pond; tilt your view and watch the Fresnel equations trade the reflections for the world beneath.
